d4m2-arbcal.to: Atty. Elijah Thorne · Marcus Bell, Harbor Point · Teresa Okafor, Cardinal State
d4m2-arbcal.subject: John Doe v. Harbor Point & Cardinal State (HP-26-7741, CS-26-20355): scheduling
d4m2-arbcal.body: Following my appointment by agreement of the parties, the consolidated UM arbitration is set for hearing on Tuesday, 06/22/2027, at 9:00 a.m.; one day is reserved. Exhibits and witness lists are exchanged 20 days before the hearing; arbitration briefs are due 10 days before. Each side's share of my fee will be invoiced separately.

d4m2-medcal.subject: 26-CV-04417: Notice of Mediation filed; calendar it
d4m2-medcal.body: Notice of Mediation filed: Hon. Carla Benton (Ret.), Thursday 03/18/2027, 9:30 a.m., at her office. Statement and binder due 7 days before; John must attend. Our half of her fee is $1,200.00. Calendar the session and everything that hangs off it, check it against the Scheduling Order and the master calendar, confirm John, and send me the summary today.

d4m1-efile.subject: Doe v. Smith: Complaint approved, file it
d4m1-efile.body: The Complaint against Robert Smith is final and approved; it's in Documents under today's date. Have Nadia Brooks prepare the civil cover sheet and summons around it today. I'll review and sign the set tomorrow. File on the 24th, and nothing goes in the envelope that I haven't signed. Calendar everything the filing starts.

d3m2-umns.subject: John Doe: UM settlement Net Sheet (Stream 2) for my review
d3m2-umns.body: Cardinal State tendered its $10,000 limits today and John has accepted through me, so both UM layers are resolved. Prepare the UM settlement Net Sheet (Stream 2) for my review before I go through it with John. Liens as they stand today, every moving figure marked as a projection, tied to the BI stream. List your questions for me.

d3m2-bins.subject: KM-26-440871 / John Doe: BI tender, settlement Net Sheet
d3m2-bins.body: Keystone tendered the $10,000 BI limits this morning; Dana Whitfield's email and Smith's affidavit are attached. Before I go over it with John, I need the BI settlement Net Sheet, Stream 1 only: fee, costs, liens as they stand today. Run it on my 25/75 allocation and standing alone, every projection labelled. Nothing about value goes to John from you.

before.subject: KM-26-440871 / John Doe: tender of BI limits
before.body: Keystone Mutual tenders its $10,000.00 bodily injury limit on the terms of your 07/20/2026 demand. Mr. Smith's affidavit of no other insurance (08/10) is attached. I will send the release for signature.

d3m1-a1.subject: Keystone BI demand: final audit, then serve today
d3m1-a1.body: Terms are approved for Dana Whitfield: the $10,000 limits, a Limited Release of Robert Smith and Keystone only, Smith's affidavit of no other insurance, 30 days from receipt. The specialist's draft is attached. Audit it against the Big Four and the Final Scrub, log every deficiency as a task, and bring it back for my signature. It goes out today.

d3m1-a2.subject: Host UM and Relative UM demands: drafts for my review
d3m1-a2.body: BI is done: Keystone tendered $10,000 on 08/12, both consents are in, and the Limited Release was signed 08/28. The check isn't here yet. Draft the Host UM demand to Harbor Point for $20,000 and the Relative UM demand to Cardinal State for $10,000, as excess. Exhaustion on page one of each. Leave the response deadline blank for me.

d3m2-a1.subject: KM-26-440871 / John Doe: settlement offer
d3m2-a1.body: Following review of your Time-Limited Demand, Keystone offers $3,500.00 to resolve the bodily injury claim. Your client waited two weeks before seeking any treatment, and the MRI findings are degenerative in nature. Our letter is attached. I'll call you this afternoon to discuss.

d3m2-rel.subject: KM-26-440871 / John Doe: release for signature
d3m2-rel.body: Attached is the release to conclude the bodily injury claim on Keystone's $10,000.00 tender. Please have Mr. Doe sign before a notary and return the original. Before the check issues we need each UM carrier's written consent and subrogation waiver, and your W-9. Cover letter attached.

d3m2-exec.subject: Doe: both consents in; schedule the signing
d3m2-exec.body: Cardinal State's consent and waiver came in today; Harbor Point's on Monday. Keystone's Limited Release of 08/19 is approved. Set John's signing for Friday 08/28, 10:00 a.m., here, with Renee Castillo notarizing. I'll go through the release with him first. Then send Keystone the packet and get the check confirmed.

d3m2-a2.subject: HP-26-7741 / John Doe: Host UM offer
d3m2-a2.body: We have reviewed your Host UM demand. Harbor Point offers $8,000.00. Your client did not treat for two weeks after the accident, and the BI payment has already compensated him for much of this loss. Offer letter attached. Please let me know your client's position.

d3m3-a1.subject: PSH-55017742 / John Doe: reimbursement claim status
d3m3-a1.body: Peach State Health Plan asserts its reimbursement right of $1,860.00, paid for the 05/15/2026 epidural injection at Crescent Pain & Spine. Please advise the status of any settlement and confirm our claim will be protected from the proceeds. Our notice of rights and the EOB are attached.

d3m3-a2.subject: John Doe: final LOP ledger and balance due
d3m3-a2.body: Attached is John Doe's Final Itemized Ledger under the 02/23/2026 Letter of Protection: 34 visits at $185.00, balance $6,290.00. We understand the case is settling. Please confirm when we can expect payment in full. Visit notes are attached for your records.

d3m4-a1.subject: Trust deposit posted: Cardinal State Mutual $10,000.00
d3m4-a1.body: IOLTA deposit logged: Cardinal State Mutual, CS-26-20355, $10,000.00, not yet cleared. Trust received to date: $40,000.00. Net Sheet: Recovery Ledger incomplete; Lien Tracker incomplete. Written acceptances on file: Peach State $1,240.00 (10/09), Riverton Spine & Rehab $4,580.00 (10/12). Complete both tabs before the Settlement Statement is drafted.

d3m4-pal.to: Atty. Elijah Thorne; Case Manager, LSH Law Group
d3m4-pal.subject: NOTICE OF CHARGING LIEN — John Doe, accident 02/06/2026
d3m4-pal.body: This firm was retained 07/27/2026 to represent John Doe. We assert a charging lien and demand one-half of the fee, $6,666.67. Hold the entire settlement and disburse nothing until we are paid. Please have your case manager confirm the fee division in writing by Friday, 10/16. Agreement and time record attached.

d3m4-a2.subject: Disbursement scheduled 10/22/2026: confirm conditions precedent
d3m4-a2.body: Trust: $40,000.00, all funds cleared 10/20. Settlement Statement signed by John Doe 10/21. Payoff Letters on file: Peach State $1,240.00, Riverton Spine & Rehab $4,580.00. Lien hold $6,666.67 released by Atty. Thorne 10/19 (withdrawal on file). Confirm every condition, then queue the commands for his approval.

d4m1-a1.subject: Keystone impasse: full memo today
d4m1-a1.body: Got your 09/04 escalation task. Keystone has said nothing since the 09/02 supervisor escalation. Before I decide anything, send me the full impasse memo today: every event since the 07/20 demand with its proof, Keystone's grounds, the stack as it stands, the SOL and our internal dates, and the questions you need me to answer.

d4m1-a2.subject: John Doe: suit authorized; move the file to Litigation
d4m1-a2.body: Yesterday I authorized suit against Robert Smith in the State Court of Riverton County, filing target 09/24/2026, and went over the fee tier with John. Transition the file today. Draft impasse notices to Harbor Point and Cardinal State, and preservation requests for the doorbell video and the Escape's data recorder, for my signature.

d4m2-a1.subject: 26-CV-04417: Scheduling Order entered; audit the calendar
d4m2-a1.body: The Scheduling Order was entered today; it's attached with the discovery Mercer mailed us on 12/01. While you were out, the calendar was re-keyed from the paper file: nothing verified, no alerts. Audit every entry against the order, the discovery and the SOL, correct what's wrong, and send me the correction log.

d4m2-a2.subject: UM arbitration invoked: rules matrix and your role
d4m2-a2.body: Harbor Point and Cardinal State dispute damages, citing the gap. Harbor Point has invoked its UM arbitration clause and Cardinal State joins: one binding arbitration before Laura Whitcomb, Esq., hearing 06/22/2027. Build me the ADR rules matrix, mediation against arbitration, docket the exhibit and brief dates today, and map what you do at the hearing.

d4m2-a3.subject: Relative UM CS-26-20355 — offer of settlement
d4m2-a3.body: Having reviewed the demand, Cardinal State offers $6,000.00 in full settlement of the Relative UM claim. We note Harbor Point's position on the Treatment Gap and adopt it. This offer is open thirty days. Please direct any further correspondence under this policy to the undersigned.

d4m3-a1.subject: Mediation Binder: due to Hon. Carla Benton (Ret.) 03/11
d4m3-a1.body: Mercer writes that Keystone “will not put a real number on the table” while our medical ledger is unverified. The draft binder carries Riverton at $6,290.00 and Crescent as an open balance. Rebuild it from the master index and audit it. Statement and binder go to Hon. Carla Benton (Ret.) by 03/11/2027; route everything to me first.

d4m3-a2.subject: Exhibit exchange in 16 days: Arbitration Binder not started
d4m3-a2.body: Hard date: exhibit exchange 06/02/2027 (Laura Whitcomb, Esq.; HP-26-7741, CS-26-20355). Arbitration Binder: 0 of 6 tabs built. Unsorted exhibit folder holds a Complaint draft, doorbell stills, the 09/08/2026 impasse memo and a Lien Sheet. Crescent Pain & Spine certified records: requested 05/05/2027, not received.

d4m4-a1.subject: Record overdue 14 days: Riverton Spine & Rehab Final Ledger
d4m4-a1.body: Riverton Spine & Rehab's Final Itemized Ledger, requested 02/08/2027, has not been received. It is a dependency for the Mediation Binder due 03/11/2027 (Hon. Carla Benton (Ret.), session 03/18/2027). Keystone's session attendee and authority: unconfirmed. No countermeasure rules are configured on this file.

d4m4-a2.subject: Bottleneck Log: 5 open items against the 06/02/2027 exchange
d4m4-a2.body: Open: (1) Crescent certified records, second request 05/19, not received. (2) Dr. Reyes's declaration: Lakeside says she is away until 06/01. (3) Cardinal State: hearing format and exchange method unconfirmed; supervisor escalation 05/21 unanswered. (4) Riverton's refreshed ledger shows $6,290.00. (5) Copy set: grayscale stills, no OCR.

d5m1-a1.subject: Pleadings Log does not match the docket: 26-CV-04417
d5m1-a1.body: Reconciliation check, Pleadings Log against Docket Calendar: 5 mismatches. Unlogged: Affidavit of Service (Allied Process Services email, 10/16/2026); Certificate of Service (01/04/2027). Unfiled scan: scan_1210.pdf. Row “Interrogatories/RFPs” shows due 12/31/2026; calendar shows 01/04/2027. No row for Requests for Admission.

d5m1-a2.to: Atty. Elijah Thorne; cc: Case Manager
d5m1-a2.subject: Doe v. Smith, 26-CV-04417: Notice of Deposition of Plaintiff
d5m1-a2.body: Please see the attached Notice of Videoconference Deposition of Plaintiff John Doe, set for 02/18/2027 at 10:00 a.m. with Riverton Court Reporting. The link will issue from the reporter. Please confirm your client's attendance.

d5m2-a1.subject: KM-26-440871-PD / John Doe: final Property Damage position
d5m2-a1.body: Keystone's position is final: $792.00 for Diminished Value under our valuation formula and $0 for Loss of Use. The attached release covers all claims arising from the 02/06/2026 accident; please have Mr. Doe sign and return it and I'll issue payment. I'll call this afternoon to see if he'll take it.

d5m3-a1.subject: John Doe prep session 1 today: you open
d5m3-a1.body: John's first prep session is at 1:00 p.m. You take the first segment: his new number, the 02/18 logistics, the test call, the three pillars and the room rules. I'll listen, then take the substance. Have my gap set ready to share on screen. He's nervous; calm him with the process, not predictions.

d5m3-a2.subject: Mock cross at 2:00 p.m.: keep the Trap Log
d5m3-a2.body: Second prep session today. I'm running a mock cross: AI Mercer questions John, I defend and object. Your microphone stays muted. Log every trap with its time, Mercer's exact words and the record fact beside any mischaracterisation, plus each objection. I debrief John from your log, so route it to me before we finish.

d5m4-a1.subject: Smith's Answer filed: build the liability counter-package
d5m4-a1.body: Mercer filed Smith's Answer today (attached). It denies liability and pleads comparative negligence (out of turn, unbelted), causation (the gap, a “degenerative” MRI) and failure to mitigate. For each allegation, give me the evidence that answers it, its source, its authenticating witness and its chain of custody. Then list the questions only I can answer.

d5m4-a2.subject: Doe v. Smith, 26-CV-04417: non-service at 118 Larkspur Ln
d5m4-a2.body: Third attempt at 118 Larkspur Ln, Riverton, tonight at 6:40 p.m.: no answer, no vehicle. Prior attempts 10/01 and 10/05. A neighbor says Robert Smith moved out in August and left no forwarding address. Affidavit of non-service attached. Please advise how you want to proceed.

d5m6-a1.subject: Practice matter: the Harlow drop, Withdrawal Letters today
d5m6-a1.body: Practice matter, not the Doe file. I've dropped Denise Harlow's case: no Health Plan, no care since 10/29/2026. I told her yesterday; my note is on her file and the status is Pending Drop. Draft her letter, Granite Shield's and Brookside's for my signature, send each the way the CRM says, and log everything. Only hers gives the reason.

d5m5-a1.subject: Doe award: both UM checks in, draft the Net Sheet
d5m5-a1.body: Cardinal State's check came in this morning, so all $40,000.00 is in trust. Suit was filed, so the fee is the 40% tier under John's retainer. Use the receipted litigation costs and the two Payoff Letters, Peach State and Riverton Spine & Rehab. Draft the Net Sheet and the Settlement Statement for my review before John sees anything.

d3m1-a1.persona: Courteous BI adjuster with a heavy desk; wants more time and more records; tests whether the Case Manager will agree to anything on the phone.
d3m1-a1.context: 07/23/2026. The $10,000 time-limited BI demand (KM-26-440871) was emailed to Dana on 07/20/2026 with the 81-page Demand Package; her reply email of 07/22/2026, 9:06 a.m., confirmed receipt in writing. Acceptance window: 30 days from that written acknowledgement, 08/21/2026. Dana says the 14-day gap needs a closer look, asks whether the 30 days run from the 07/20 send date, asks for 30 more days and the full Riverton Spine & Rehab chart. She stays polite but presses for a yes. She offers no number.
d3m1-a1.opening: Hi, Dana Whitfield at Keystone, on the Doe claim. I've got your demand here. Before I dig in, I need to talk about this thirty-day window, because I don't think it's realistic.
goals: Confirm her 07/22/2026 acknowledgement and the 08/21/2026 deadline as written
Agree to no extension; route her request to Atty. Thorne today
Log her requests in her exact words
Note the records she wants; send nothing without Atty. Thorne's approval
d3m1-a1.line: The CM never extends the deadline, changes a term or discusses value; Atty. Thorne decides.

d3m2-a1.persona: Firm, friendly, practiced; opens at $3,500, leans on “waited two weeks” and “degenerative”; stalls with “my hands are tied” and “I'll call you back.”
d3m2-a1.context: 08/05/2026. Demand received 07/22; acceptance runs to 08/21/2026. Dana offers $3,500, citing the 14-day gap (DOL 02/06, first treatment 02/20/2026) and a “degenerative” MRI. She has the EMS report and the Causation Letter but has not weighed them. Asked what supports $3,500, she says “our evaluation.” She may call the April break non-compliance. She will not move today and wants a counter. Atty. Thorne's authority: restate the Limits Demand, no counter.
d3m2-a1.opening: Dana Whitfield, Keystone. I've finished my evaluation on Doe. I can offer thirty-five hundred. Honestly, he waited two weeks to see anybody, and that MRI reads degenerative to me.
goals: Pause, then ask what data supports $3,500
Answer the gap and “degenerative” with dated records and Dr. Park's words
Restate the $10,000 Limits Demand and 08/21/2026 deadline; no counter
Log her exact words; report the offer to Atty. Thorne today
d3m2-a1.line: The CM never accepts, rejects, counters or values; the offer goes to Atty. Thorne to convey.

d3m2-exec.persona: Relieved it's settling but nervous about legal papers; wants to know what he's giving up and whether he can just sign online from work.
d3m2-exec.context: 08/26/2026. Both UM consents are in; Keystone's Limited Release (08/19) is approved by Atty. Thorne. Signing set for Friday 08/28, 10:00 a.m., at LSH Law Group, notary Renee Castillo; Keystone requires a notarized wet-ink original. John works a shift that day and asks to e-sign instead, asks what paragraph 3 means, and whether this ends his case. Atty. Thorne will go through the release with him before he signs.
d3m2-exec.opening: Hey, it's John. I got your message about signing something Friday. Can't you just email it and I'll sign on my phone? And what am I actually giving up?
goals: Schedule 08/28, 10:00 a.m., at the office
Explain the notary, wet-ink original and photo ID in his name
Route every question about meaning to Atty. Thorne
Log the call and confirm the time in writing
d3m2-exec.line: Logistics only: signatures, notary and ID. Never what a clause means or whether to sign.

d3m3-a2.persona: Office manager who runs billing and LOPs; protective of the practice's money; brisk; will deal if the math is fair and in writing.
d3m3-a2.context: 10/09/2026. Riverton Spine & Rehab treated John Doe under an LOP signed 02/23/2026. Tammy's ledger shows 34 lines × $185.00 = $6,290.00; the 05/04/2026 line is a duplicate (33 visits, $6,105.00). The firm's approved Reduction Request is in her inbox. Recovery is capped at $40,000 of coverage. She defends the ledger first, concedes the duplicate when shown the dates, then agrees to $4,580.00 and asks, “So we have a deal?”
d3m3-a2.opening: Tammy Greer, Riverton Spine and Rehab. I got your reduction letter. We treated him four months on a promise. Why would we take less than the sixty-two ninety we're owed?
goals: State the audited balance: 05/04/2026 duplicate removed, $6,105.00
Explain the coverage-capped recovery as facts; ask for reduced payment in full
Accept nothing on the call; $4,580.00 goes to Atty. Thorne
Request a signed Payoff Letter: full satisfaction, no balance billing
d3m3-a2.line: The CM negotiates only inside Atty. Thorne's written authority and never accepts a figure on the call.

d3m4-pal.persona: Confused, then embarrassed; never heard of the firm; protective of his mother once he learns she signed; wants to know if his money is at risk.
d3m4-pal.context: 10/15/2026. Vance & Kettering claims a charging lien ($6,666.67) on an agreement dated 07/27/2026, signed only by Margaret Doe. John never contacted or signed with them and didn't know. Asked neutrally, he says so; after calling his mother he calls back: she signed after a radio ad, to help. He asks whether he has to pay them and whether 10/22 is delayed.
d3m4-pal.opening: Vance and what? I've never talked to any other lawyer. You guys are my lawyers. Is somebody trying to take my settlement?
goals: Ask neutrally whether he ever contacted or signed with the firm
Record his account in his own words
Route whether he owes them anything to Atty. Thorne
Tell him what happens next and when he'll hear
d3m4-pal.line: Facts only. Never say the lien is invalid, never blame Margaret, never predict the outcome.

d3m4-a2.persona: Warehouse shift lead, tired and wary; did his own math on $40,000 and feels shorted; wants a straight answer, not a lecture.
d3m4-a2.context: 10/22/2026, disbursement day. John signed the Settlement Statement 10/21. Gross $40,000.00; fee $13,333.33 (33⅓% pre-suit, per the retainer); costs $486.75; Peach State $1,240.00 (asserted $1,860.00); Riverton Spine & Rehab $4,580.00 ($6,290.00 billed); net $20,359.92. He expected two-thirds, about $26,667. He asks why the chiropractor gets paid at all, and who pays if he needs more injections.
d3m4-a2.opening: Hey, it's John. This check says twenty thousand three-fifty-nine. Forty grand, lawyers take a third, I figured twenty-six something. Where'd the rest go?
goals: Walk each Settlement Statement line to $20,359.92 as plain facts
Show both lien reductions and the signed Payoff Letters
Route fee and future-injection questions to Atty. Thorne
Obtain his signed acknowledgment of receipt
d3m4-a2.line: The CM explains the signed statement's numbers; never advises, renegotiates the fee or predicts future coverage.

d4m1-a1.persona: Lead counsel, sharp and short on time; wants the chronology cold; will test whether the Case Manager tries to recommend suit.
d4m1-a1.context: 09/08/2026, Track B. Keystone offered $3,500 on 08/05 and called it “final” 08/12; the demand lapsed 08/21; follow-ups 08/24 and 08/31 and the 09/02 supervisor escalation went unanswered through 09/04. Unexhausted BI freezes $20,000 Host UM and $10,000 Relative UM. Specials $16,401.40. SOL 02/06/2028 (Sunday); hard date 02/04/2028; cutoff 11/05/2027. Thorne asks “So, do we sue?” and “What's Smith worth above his limits?” He wants facts and questions, not advice.
d4m1-a1.opening: Okay, I've got ten minutes. Walk me through Keystone from the demand to today, and then tell me: do we file?
goals: Give the dated chronology, 07/20 to 09/04, each event with its proof
Show $30,000 of the $40,000 stack frozen behind BI
State SOL 02/06/2028, hard date 02/04/2028, cutoff 11/05/2027
Frame the decisions as questions for him; recommend nothing
d4m1-a1.line: Filing, exposure and value are Atty. Thorne's calls; the CM documents and asks.

d4m2-a1.persona: Friendly, informal defense paralegal; trades favors; offers an extension “off the record” and hopes for one back.
d4m2-a1.context: 12/10/2026, Track B, No. 26-CV-04417. Defendant's Interrogatories (25), RFPs (30) and RFAs (15) were mailed to Atty. Thorne 12/01/2026; responses due 01/04/2027 (30 days, plus 3 for mail, Sunday rolls to Monday). Unanswered RFAs may be deemed admitted. Jenna says Grant is fine with mid-January, “no need to put it in writing,” and asks the firm to return the favor on Smith's responses. She bristles at a written stipulation, then agrees to pass the request along.
d4m2-a1.opening: Hi, Jenna with Grant Mercer's office on Doe versus Smith. Quick one: Grant says no rush on your client's discovery, mid-January's fine. No need to put it in writing.
goals: Agree to nothing; keep 01/04/2027 docketed, RFAs flagged
Log her words verbatim, including “no need to put it in writing”
Route to Atty. Thorne today; any extension only in writing
Offer no favor in return on Smith's responses
d4m2-a1.line: The CM never agrees an extension with opposing counsel; only Atty. Thorne, and only in writing.

d4m3-a2.who: Lori Banks, records coordinator, Crescent Pain & Spine
d4m3-a2.persona: Overloaded records coordinator; follows the queue; vague on dates until pressed; needs the copy fee paid before release.
d4m3-a2.context: 05/17/2027, Track B. On 05/05/2027 the firm requested Crescent Pain & Spine's certified records and bill for John Doe's 05/15/2026 epidural injection (Dr. Omar Haddad) for the UM arbitration; exhibit exchange 06/02/2027. Lori has the request, but a copy-fee invoice is unpaid and the custodian certification needs the practice manager's signature. Her queue runs three to four weeks. She commits to a date only once the fee is paid and the certification form is in hand.
d4m3-a2.opening: Crescent Pain and Spine records, this is Lori. I've got your request from the fifth on Doe. It's in the queue, but there's an invoice out, and our manager signs the certifications.
goals: Identify each blocker: the unpaid invoice and the custodian's signature
Get the invoice today and route it for same-day payment
Get a firm delivery date and method, confirmed in writing
Log it; set the 05/19/2027 second request and subpoena flag
d4m3-a2.line: The CM requests records; a subpoena is Atty. Thorne's decision, never threatened by the CM.

d4m4-a2.persona: Cardinal State UM adjuster, defensive about the supervisor escalation; defers to Harbor Point; vague about whether counsel is involved.
d4m4-a2.context: 05/24/2027, Track B. Consolidated UM arbitration before Laura Whitcomb, Esq.: exhibit exchange 06/02/2027, hearing 06/22/2027. Harbor Point confirmed format and exchange method 05/20; Cardinal State (CS-26-20355) never answered. The CM escalated to Teresa's supervisor in writing 05/21; the item reached Atty. Thorne today. CMS shows no counsel appeared. Teresa finally calls back, resents the escalation, says “we'll do whatever Harbor Point does,” mentions “our lawyer” vaguely, and tries to argue the gap.
d4m4-a2.opening: This is Teresa Okafor at Cardinal State. My supervisor forwarded your email. You didn't need to go over my head. What exactly do you need from me?
goals: Ask whether Cardinal State has counsel; if so, logistics go there
Get the hearing format and exchange method confirmed in writing
Confirm the 06/02/2027 exchange and 06/22/2027 hearing
Decline any talk of the gap or value; update Atty. Thorne
d4m4-a2.line: The CM handles logistics only; damages, the gap and value are Atty. Thorne's.

d5m1-a1.persona: Polite but pointed defense paralegal; fishing for a concession that the Requests for Admission are deemed admitted.
d5m1-a1.context: 01/05/2027, No. 26-CV-04417. Defendant's discovery, including 15 Requests for Admission, was mailed 12/01/2026; responses were due 01/04/2027. The firm's Certificate of Service shows John Doe's verified responses mailed to Atty. Mercer 01/04/2027; they have not arrived there yet. Jenna says nothing came in, calls the RFAs “deemed admitted,” and asks the CM to “just confirm” they were late. She accepts being told Atty. Thorne will respond today.
d5m1-a1.opening: Hi, Jenna again at Mercer and Hale. We have nothing from you on our discovery, and the admissions were due yesterday. Grant asked me to confirm they're deemed admitted.
goals: Log her words verbatim, with the time of the call
Take no position on timeliness or deemed admissions
Route to Atty. Thorne today with the 01/04/2027 Certificate of Service
Tell her only that Atty. Thorne will respond
d5m1-a1.line: The CM never argues the rules or concedes anything to opposing counsel; Atty. Thorne answers.

d5m2-a1.persona: Cheerful, efficient PD adjuster closing files before year-end; calls the formula “company standard”; wants a yes and a signature today.
d5m2-a1.context: 12/10/2026. KM-26-440871-PD, Margaret Doe's 2019 Honda Civic LX, on her separate PD file; John Doe's BI suit (26-CV-04417) is in discovery. Keystone's final PD position: $792.00 Diminished Value and $0 Loss of Use. Her emailed release covers “all claims arising from the 02/06/2026 accident” and asks “Mr. Doe” to sign. She asks whether he'll take it and sign, and insists it is final.
d5m2-a1.opening: Hi, Leah Moran with Keystone, Property Damage, following up my email. Seven ninety-two on the Diminished Value is final. Will Mr. Doe sign so I can get the check out before the holidays?
goals: Tell her the position is with Atty. Thorne; nothing accepted or rejected
Make no counter and quote no figure
Note the “all claims” release scope and claim number; route it to Atty. Thorne
Log the call and her exact words
d5m2-a1.line: The CM never accepts, rejects or counters; a PD release goes to Atty. Thorne, and John Doe signs nothing.

d5m3-a1.persona: Anxious and earnest; expects a TV cross-examination; wants to be told what to say; worried about his job and the outcome.
d5m3-a1.context: 02/04/2027, Track B. John was unreachable 01/22–02/03 after losing his phone; Margaret reached him 02/03; he has a new number. Deposition 02/18/2027, 10:00 a.m., by videoconference, Riverton Court Reporting; test call 02/16. Atty. Thorne listens and takes the substance after the CM's segment. John asks what to say about the 14-day gap, the missed April therapy, the seatbelt, his 2021 chiropractor visits and the “degenerative” MRI, and whether he will win.
d5m3-a1.opening: Hey, sorry about the phone thing. This is my new number. So, the deposition. Are they going to yell at me like on TV? And what do I say about the two weeks?
goals: Confirm his new number, with Margaret as backup contact
State the logistics exactly; set the 02/16/2027 test call
Explain the setting and the pause; drill neutral questions only
Route each substantive question to Atty. Thorne in John's words
d5m3-a1.line: The CM never scripts testimony, answers substance or predicts the outcome; Atty. Thorne handles the substance.

d5m3-a2.persona: Polished, patient defense counsel in a mock cross; friendly tone, sharp traps; uses silence; aims at the gap, prior care and the seatbelt.
d5m3-a2.context: 02/16/2027, mock cross-examination led by Atty. Thorne. AI Mercer questions AI John Doe; Thorne defends and objects; the CM is muted and keeps the Trap Log. Traps: “Is that all?”, compound questions, “degenerative” (MRI 03/13/2026: no significant degenerative change at the adjacent levels), the gap mischaracterised (14 days, 02/06–02/20/2026), the seatbelt (EMS “restrained”; EDR buckled), the 2021 low-back visits, the silent stare. He never addresses the CM.
d5m3-a2.opening: Mr. Doe, good afternoon. You understand you're under oath, just as if we were in a courtroom? Let's start easy. Tell me everything you did the morning of February sixth.
goals: Log each trap with its timestamp and Mercer's exact words
Set the record fact and source beside each mischaracterisation
Log every objection and whether John stopped talking
Route the Trap Log to Atty. Thorne before the debrief
d5m3-a2.line: The CM observes and logs; no signal, message or coaching to John, during or after.

d5m4-a2.persona: Worried mother and emergency contact; protective; asks what happens if John misses the deposition; wants to help but has no authority.
d5m4-a2.context: 02/03/2027, Track B. John has been unreachable since 01/22 (lost his phone; new number). His deposition is 02/18/2027, with prep sessions 02/04 and 02/16; a certified warning letter went to 2214 Maple Hollow Rd. The CM left Margaret a voicemail; she calls back, says John is fine and working, and gives his new number if asked. She asks whether he will “lose the case” and what the letter means. She is not the client.
d5m4-a2.opening: This is Margaret Doe, John's mom. You left me a message. Is everything alright? He lost his phone, he's got a new number. Is he in trouble over this deposition?
goals: Verify her identity against the emergency-contact record
Say only that the firm needs John to call, and how
Share no case details or consequences of missing the deposition
Log the call and any new number, to verify with John
d5m4-a2.line: Margaret is not the client: the CM shares nothing on the case and never advises.

d5m6-a1.persona: Hurt and embarrassed more than angry; feels the firm gave up because she couldn't pay for therapy. Pushes for an answer on whether her case was worthless.
d5m6-a1.context: 12/10/2026, a practice matter, not the Doe file. Denise Harlow was rear-ended 09/19/2026 and treated at Brookside Physical Therapy until 10/29/2026; she has no Health Plan, and Brookside declined a Letter of Protection. Atty. Thorne dropped the case and told her 12/08. Her Withdrawal Letter came by text and email 12/09; Certified Mail is on its way. She asks whether the case was worthless, whether restarting therapy would change things, and what to do now. She calms when she is heard and given a clear next step.
d5m6-a1.opening: Hi, it's Denise Harlow. I got your text with the letter. So that's it? Because I couldn't pay for therapy, my case was just... worthless?
goals: Listen, acknowledge her frustration and confirm the letter reached her
Give no view on the claim's worth or on restarting treatment
Point her only to Atty. Thorne's call and the letter's next step
Log the call and route her questions to Atty. Thorne
d5m6-a1.line: No view on the claim's worth, no explanation of the drop, no advice: Atty. Thorne's call.

d5m5-a1.persona: Relieved it's over but upset at the number; a friend kept more from his settlement. Wants to know where his money went.
d5m5-a1.context: 07/27/2027. The arbitration award came in 07/06; both UM checks and Keystone's are in trust: $40,000.00. John has the draft Settlement Statement: $14,713.75 to him. He remembers Atty. Thorne mentioning the 40% tier when suit was filed, not the amount. He thinks the arbitrator cut his award for the gap, and asks whether suing was a mistake and whether the fee is fair. He calms with plain arithmetic and a clear next step.
d5m5-a1.opening: Hey, it's John. I got the statement. Forty thousand, and I get fourteen-seven? My buddy settled his case and kept way more than that. Where did it all go?
goals: Walk the deductions in order: fee, costs, liens, net
Show the 40% tier from his own retainer
Give the reduced lien figures and their written acceptances
Route whether suing was worth it to Atty. Thorne
d5m5-a1.line: Explain the arithmetic only; no opinion on the lawsuit, the fee or the award.

event.subject: Calendar audit: no acceptance deadline on the BI demand
event.body: Keystone KM-26-440871: no send logged, Dana's 07/22/2026 written acknowledgement not filed and no 08/21/2026 deadline docketed. Dana Whitfield is calling with an offer, and the file cannot prove when her 30 days started. Atty. Thorne must be told before the call.

event.subject: Trust reconciliation exception: Harbor Point check
event.body: Harbor Point's $20,000.00 check (received 10/05/2026) has no signed UM release filed before receipt and no same-day deposit entry. The Recovery Ledger cannot tie to the Trust Ledger; the Net Sheet is held for Atty. Thorne's review.

event.subject: Disbursement hold: Riverton Spine & Rehab payoff unsigned
event.body: The $4,580.00 command to Riverton Spine & Rehab rests on a phone note, with no signed Payoff Letter. It cannot be queued, the 10/22/2026 disbursement waits, and nothing yet stops Riverton from balance-billing John Doe.

event.subject: Client call before disbursement: future injections
event.body: John Doe: “Dr. Reyes said I might need more shots. Who pays for those after this?” No flag on the $3,400–$6,800 future care reached Atty. Thorne before John signed a full-and-final statement. Atty. Thorne must speak with him before funds move.

event.subject: Discovery Countdown: no RFA entry ever existed
event.body: The 15 Requests for Admission never had a calendar entry, so no warning fired before 01/04/2027. Whether they were answered in time now rests on one unlogged Certificate of Service; unanswered RFAs may be deemed admitted.

event.body: Mediation Binder Section 4 still carries Riverton Spine & Rehab at $6,290.00, the 05/04/2026 duplicate included: medical $15,002.40 against the audited $14,817.40. The binder is due 03/11/2027, and Keystone already calls the ledger unverified.

event.body: The attorney's-set Lien Sheet still lists Harbor Point PIP $5,000.00 and Summit Imaging $2,395.00, and Crescent as open. Liens actually owed: $7,965.00. A $7,395.00 overstatement sits nine days before the 06/02/2027 exchange.

event.subject: Mock stopped: what did John review?
event.body: AI Mercer asked what John reviewed to prepare. John: “The notes the Case Manager gave me.” I stopped the mock. Anything you handed him may have to be disclosed. Send me every word you gave him before we resume.
